meta_description_ru: Редакторская колонка Alone Coder в газете ACNews #76. Размышления о состоянии демосцены ZX Spectrum, проблемах с разработкой игр и нехватке командной работы.
meta_description_en: Editorial column by Alone Coder in ACNews #76. Thoughts on the state of the ZX Spectrum demoscene, game development issues, and the lack of team collaboration.
body_ru_plain:
Новости
                        by Alone Coder

Прошёл год, и я снова выпускаю газету. Для меня этот год был не
очень производительным - по причинам, связанным с лингвистикой,
о чём я напишу отдельно (нажмите "2" ). Планируется выпустить и
журнал, но для этого я жду независимые материалы.

В прошлом номере я предлагал собрать полноценную команду для
разработки игр высочайшего качества (кроме шуток), но никто не
откликнулся. Такое сейчас положение дел на спектрумовской сцене
- авторы хотят раскручивать не платформу, а себя. Особенно это
касается художников, для которых размножились разнообразные
сольные конкурсы. Работы, нарисованные не под серьёзный релиз, а
под конкурс, можно считать временем, слитым в унитаз. В
результате, например, до сих пор нет графики для Worms и НЛО-2
(при этом для него есть специально написанная новая музыка!), а
также не докрашена игра "Вера". И это всё не самые сложные
проекты для художника. Например, для написания нового Wolf 3D и
нового Ball Quest (а для них есть готовые движки) художник уже
должен проявить креативность.

Поскольку я на платформе сижу 32 года без перерывов (и похоже,
что я такой остался один, остальные забивали в те или иные годы,
потом время от времени возвращались), могу засвидетельствовать,
что так было не всегда. Художники рисовали под проекты так же,
как и кодеры пишут под проекты, а не просто так. Музыканты
делали запас музыки для будущих крупных релизов, а не
выбрасывали её на очередное компо, работы с которого мало кто
слушает (на демопати люди даже часто убегали из зала во время
музыкальных конкурсов). Сейчас из сцены ZX Spectrum пытаются
сделать что-то типа тусовки хипстеров для продажи им товаров с
ретролейблами (разные тусовки хипстеров отличаются лейблами, но
суть этого бизнеса одна и та же). Под такими же лейблами,
перекупленными у старых владельцев, выпускается и новодел.
Видно, что в России продажи этого мусора идут не очень, поэтому
я надеюсь, что старая ситуация всё-таки вернётся, и мы должны
быть готовы к возрождению групп. Недавно была попытка создать
виртуальную группу на Discord, я присоединялся к ней, но
организатор вскоре исчез без следа. Может быть, следующий раз
будет удачнее. Я уверен, что ответственных людей у нас много,
нужно только собрать волю в кулак.

Как должны выглядеть полноценные, хорошо задизайненные
инди-игры, многие видели в обзорах типа "Рефанд". Графика - это
первое, что видит тот, кто прикасается к игре. И графики должно
быть достаточно, чтобы игрок всё время видел что-то новое.
Хорошая игра раскручивает платформу, а платформа - игру. Но у
нас до сих пор нет игр, где графики было бы хотя бы на несколько
полных подгрузок по 128К (даже и на одну, учитывая возможности
компрессии) - не говоря уж о мегабайтных моделях, которые
выпускаются как минимум с 1992 года, а сейчас доступны абсолютно
всем пользователям хотя бы в виде эмулятора. Вместо этого
выпускается множество маленьких игр, которые не в силах
рекламировать ZX Spectrum и сами будут быстро забыты.

Может быть, кому-то из читателей будет интересен сценарий игры
про спектрумистов, где можно будет заново прожить 90-е - нажмите
"4". Сценарий в основном писал я, с дополнениями от NS и с
ценами из достоверных источников. Предполагается вид сбоку в
стиле River City Ransom, карта на основе некоторых районов
Москвы с соединением скроллируемых зон-улиц по статичным
зонам-площадям. Но графики, как всегда, нет.

Я поднял старые исходники демы Nedodemo и обнаружил версии
эффектов под 6912. Уже пересобрал первый эффект (mode7) под 48К.
Ранее я выкладывал версию просмотрщика полноэкранного
мультиколора (ZX-Guide #2) под фирменный 48К. Правда, я в глаза
не видел фирменные 48К и только мельком и поздно - фирменные +2.

John начал писать новый музон. Я тоже периодически начинаю, но с
детьми на фоне ничего особо не выходит. Доделан был только музон
для новогодней демы. Мы также иногда вспоминаем прошлое и играем
в шахматы с ним и с моим сыном Сашей (нажмите "6" ).

Kulich, galstaff и LVD выпустили новые утилиты под NedoOS.

Я ездил к Максагору и видел, как он коннектится с ATM-Turbo к
реальной BBSке (они ещё существуют!).

Urfin выпустил две игры под ATM-Turbo, которые понравились моим
детям.

Ldir засветился по рязанскому телевидению в связи с эффектами на
светодиодных экранах: https://vk.com/wall1660020_3937 .

Dragons' Lord продолжает писать Quake на моём 3D-движке, который
постоянно обновляется (текущая версия 1.45 ). Демо-версия игры
была представлена на Yandex Retro Games Battle 2023 под
названием "Борщ". Движок позволяет одновременно собирать игру
под 128K (кассета и диск), ATM-Turbo 2 и 48K (кассета, урезанная
по графике версия). Исходники движка и примеров открыты,
спрашивайте в Дискорде или мылом.

Week of the Agents сообщает, что в разработке игра Хабар с
геймплеем, похожим, на первую King's Bounty, но в мире Зоны из
игры S.T.A.L.K.E.R.

Компьютер у меня сейчас шалит, если не сказать больше. Постоянно
виснет или выключается (раньше он это делал только при
включенной плате WiFi), а заодно иногда включает режим залипания
каких-то клавиш, хотя в настройках он всегда выключен. Пытался
найти в интернете решение проблемы (а она проявлялась у многих)
- ничего не помогло. Помогают только перезагрузки.
body_en_plain:
News
                        by Alone Coder

One more year has passed, and here is a newspaper again. For me,
this year was not very productive - for reasons related to
linguistics, which I will write about separately (click "3" ). I
also plan to release a magazine (Info Guide), but for this I am
waiting for independent articles and music.

In the last issue, I proposed to assemble a full-fledged team to
develop games of the highest quality (no jokes), but no one
responded. This is the current state of affairs on the Spectrum
scene - the authors want to promote not the platform, but
themselves. This is especially true for artists for whom a
variety of solo competitions have proliferated. Works drawn not
for a serious release, but for a competition, can be considered
time flushed down the toilet. As a result, for example, there
are still no graphics for Worms and UFO-2 (although there is new
music specially written for it!), and the colour version of Vera
has not been completed. And these are not the most difficult
projects for an artist. For example, to design a new Wolf 3D and
a new Ball Quest (and there are ready-made engines for them), an
artist must be truly creative.

Since I've been sitting on the platform for 32 years without a
break (and it looks like I'm the only one left, the others have
quit and returned, time to time), I can testify that this was
not always the case. Artists drew for projects in the same way
that coders wrote for projects. Musicians prepared songs for
future major releases, rather than throwing them away on the
next compo, which few people listen to (at demo parties, people
often ran away from the hall during music competitions). Now
some people are trying to turn the ZX Spectrum scene into
something like a hipster hangout to sell them goods with retro
labels (different hipster hangouts have different labels, but
the essence of this business is the same). Different stuff is
also being released under the same labels, that were purchased
from the old owners. It can be seen that sales of this garbage
are not going well in Russia, so I hope that the old situation
will return, and we must be ready for the revival of groups.
Recently there was an attempt to create a virtual group in
Discord, I joined it, but the organizer soon disappeared without
a trace. Maybe next time will be better. I am sure that we have
a lot of responsible people, we just need to have willpower.

Many people have seen what full-fledged, well-designed indie
games should look like in YouTube reviews like "Refund".
Graphics are the first thing that anyone sees in a game. And the
graphics should be enough so that the player sees something new
all the time. A good game promotes the platform, and the
platform promotes the game. But we still dont have games with
graphics for at least several full 128K loads (even just
one, taking into account the compression capabilities) - not to
mention the megabyte models that have been produced since 1992,
and are now available for all the users, at least in the form of
an emulator. Instead, a lot of small games are released every
year that are unable to advertise the ZX Spectrum and will
themselves be quickly forgotten.

Maybe some readers will be interested in a game scenario about
Spectrum users, where they can relive the 90's - press "5". The
script was mainly written by me, with additions from NS and
prices from reliable sources. A side view in the style of River
City Ransom is assumed, a map based on some districts of Moscow
with a connection of scrollable zones-streets by static
zones-squares. But, as always, there are no graphics.

I pulled up the old sources of Nedodemo and found versions of
its effects for 6912 screen. I have already rebuilt the first
effect (mode7) for 48K. Previously, I released a version of the
full-screen multicolor viewer (ZX-Guide #2) for the branded
48K. Frankly, I never saw the branded 48K and only briefly and
late - the branded +2.

John started writing a new music. I also start from time to
time, but with children in the background nothing really works
out. Only the music for the New Year's demo was completed. We
also sometimes remember the past and play chess with John and my
son Sasha (press "7" ).

Kulich, galstaff, and LVD made new utilities for NedoOS.

I visited Maksagor and saw how he uses ATM-Turbo to connect to a
BBS (they still exist!).

Urfin released two ATM-Turbo games that my children liked.

Ldir appeared on Ryazan television in connection with the
effects on LED screens: https://vk.com/wall1660020_3937.

Dragons' Lord continues to write Quake on my 3D engine, which is
constantly updated (currently it's v1.45 ). A demo version of
the game was presented at Yandex Retro Games Battle 2023 under
the name "Borsch". The engine allows you to simultaneously
compile the game under 128K (tape and disk), ATM-Turbo 2 (in
full colour) and 48K (tape, graphics-reduced version). The
sources of the engine and examples are open, feel free to ask in
Discord or via email.

Week of the Agents reports that he is developing a game named
Habar (Swag) with gameplay similar to the first King's Bounty,
but in the world of the Zone from S.T.A.L.K.E.R.

My computer is acting strange right now, to say the least. It
constantly freezes or turns off (previously it only did this
when the WiFi card was turned on), and sometimes turns on the
sticky key mode, although it is always turned off in the
settings. I tried to find a solution to the problem on the
Internet (many people had the same problem) - nothing helped.
Only reboots help.

## News

```text
                        by Alone Coder
```

One more year has passed, and here is a newspaper again. For me, this year was not very productive - for reasons related to linguistics, which I will write about separately (click "3" ). I also plan to release a magazine (Info Guide), but for this I am waiting for independent articles and music.

In the last issue, I proposed to assemble a full-fledged team to develop games of the highest quality (no jokes), but no one responded. This is the current state of affairs on the Spectrum scene - the authors want to promote not the platform, but themselves. This is especially true for artists for whom a variety of solo competitions have proliferated. Works drawn not for a serious release, but for a competition, can be considered time flushed down the toilet. As a result, for example, there are still no graphics for Worms and UFO-2 (although there is new music specially written for it!), and the colour version of Vera has not been completed. And these are not the most difficult projects for an artist. For example, to design a new Wolf 3D and a new Ball Quest (and there are ready-made engines for them), an artist must be truly creative.

Since I've been sitting on the platform for 32 years without a break (and it looks like I'm the only one left, the others have quit and returned, time to time), I can testify that this was not always the case. Artists drew for projects in the same way that coders wrote for projects. Musicians prepared songs for future major releases, rather than throwing them away on the next compo, which few people listen to (at demo parties, people often ran away from the hall during music competitions). Now some people are trying to turn the ZX Spectrum scene into something like a hipster hangout to sell them goods with retro labels (different hipster hangouts have different labels, but the essence of this business is the same). Different stuff is also being released under the same labels, that were purchased from the old owners. It can be seen that sales of this garbage are not going well in Russia, so I hope that the old situation will return, and we must be ready for the revival of groups. Recently there was an attempt to create a virtual group in Discord, I joined it, but the organizer soon disappeared without a trace. Maybe next time will be better. I am sure that we have a lot of responsible people, we just need to have willpower.

Many people have seen what full-fledged, well-designed indie games should look like in YouTube reviews like "Refund". Graphics are the first thing that anyone sees in a game. And the graphics should be enough so that the player sees something new all the time. A good game promotes the platform, and the platform promotes the game. But we still dont have games with graphics for at least several full 128K loads (even just one, taking into account the compression capabilities) - not to mention the megabyte models that have been produced since 1992, and are now available for all the users, at least in the form of an emulator. Instead, a lot of small games are released every year that are unable to advertise the ZX Spectrum and will themselves be quickly forgotten.

Maybe some readers will be interested in a game scenario about Spectrum users, where they can relive the 90's - press "5". The script was mainly written by me, with additions from NS and prices from reliable sources. A side view in the style of River City Ransom is assumed, a map based on some districts of Moscow with a connection of scrollable zones-streets by static zones-squares. But, as always, there are no graphics.

I pulled up the old sources of Nedodemo and found versions of its effects for 6912 screen. I have already rebuilt the first effect (mode7) for 48K. Previously, I released a version of the full-screen multicolor viewer (ZX-Guide #2) for the branded 48K. Frankly, I never saw the branded 48K and only briefly and late - the branded +2.

John started writing a new music. I also start from time to time, but with children in the background nothing really works out. Only the music for the New Year's demo was completed. We also sometimes remember the past and play chess with John and my son Sasha (press "7" ).

Kulich, galstaff, and LVD made new utilities for NedoOS.

Dragons' Lord continues to write Quake on my 3D engine, which is constantly updated (currently it's v1.45 ). A demo version of the game was presented at Yandex Retro Games Battle 2023 under the name "Borsch". The engine allows you to simultaneously compile the game under 128K (tape and disk), ATM-Turbo 2 (in full colour) and 48K (tape, graphics-reduced version). The sources of the engine and examples are open, feel free to ask in Discord or via email.
